summaries.summary: Cyclone Arnab is approaching the Andhra coast, leading to the evacuation of over 89,000 people, and schools and trains have been canceled in preparation for its landfall.
Loss reports from iPhone Duo users indicate cracks in screens, prompting Apple to announce a replacement policy for affected units.
OpenAI has transformed its coding tools into a personal assistant called 'dots,' which operates continuously.
The Brazilian election results have been accepted by Bolsonaro’s party despite Trump labeling the vote as 'rigged,' amidst ongoing tensions and protests.
New MacBook Pro and iMac are soon expected to be unveiled with an M6 chip during Apple's upcoming event.
Instagram plans to shift from short-form to longer-form content, allowing videos of up to 90 minutes, marking a significant strategic change.
In Israel's upcoming election, major candidates are addressing critical issues including corruption and political stability.
India advocates for reforms in the UN Security Council to allow veto powers for all permanent members, rejecting any notion of second-class status.
PHP has issued a security update for Windows to address a critical code execution vulnerability related to Brotli.
Apple has unveiled a new iPad mini featuring an OLED display and enhanced performance with the A20 Pro chip.
